systems.CRM / customer master: Accounts, bill address, hierarchy → CMF, EXTERNAL_ID_ACCT_MAP
systems.Product catalog: Plans, prices, discounts → RATE_RC, RATE_USAGE, USAGE_TYPES, DISCOUNT_DEFINITIONS
systems.Order management: New lines, plan changes, disconnects → SERVICE, PRODUCT (Orders Services)
systems.Subscriptions / installed base: Active products, contracts → PRODUCT, contract tables
systems.Online charging (OCS / CCS / CHF): Pre-rated EDRs, recharges → CDR_DATA via CAP (pre-rated usage)
systems.Mediation: Normalised CDR files → COM → MCAP → CAP → LTP → CDR_DATA
systems.Billing / invoicing: Bill run output: BILL_INVOICE, BILL_INVOICE_DETAIL, CMF_BALANCE, BILL_IMAGE
systems.Payments and collections: Payments, dunning → BMF, PAYMENT_TRANS (LBX / CPM / EFT), ARM_*
systems.MNP / port-out: Port-out disconnect → final bill (SERVICE / PRODUCT inactive dates)
systems.Service orchestration & activation: Activation result sets service start date → Orders Services
